versions.changelog: SEO/AEO/GEO-optimized docs: richer features, FAQ, comparison table, geo/local section, accurate CLI quick-start; README badges. No code changes.

ascii-art-creator 2.0.0

- Major update with expanded features and streamlined usage.
- New commands and flags for banners, boxes, cowsay, tables, and image-to-ASCII, now supporting 3 fonts and 4 box styles.
- 5 cow faces available for cowsay-style output.
- Built-in self-test command for CI and local verification.
- CI scripts and documentation added for better integration and testing.
- No external dependencies; pure Python standard library.

Initial release of ASCII Art Creator — a zero-dependency Python CLI for classic ASCII art.

- Generates figlet-style banners with multiple fonts (`standard`, `block`, `slant`)
- Creates unicode boxes with various border styles (`single`, `double`, `round`, `thick`)
- Implements cowsay with 5 different cow faces
- Renders ASCII tables from structured data
- Converts images to ASCII art (grayscale, adjustable width)
- All features require only the Python standard library; no external dependencies
